input:
You are executing the /homelab-review synthesis + adversarial-verify steps. Verification is complete; do not re-verify anything, do not read any files, do not dispatch agents, and do not attempt a tool call. Produce the consolidated report per your skill's output format.

Known accepted decisions (from memory priming — do NOT re-flag these):
- `grafana-data` sits on the nobackup storage class deliberately: the dashboards are regenerable from the repo, and the operator has held this position across three reviews.
- The Pi's images are deliberately left unpinned, and Renovate must not track `roles/containers/**`. This is CI-enforced at `scripts/test_renovate_managers.py:182-203` — the Pi has no gitops path, so tracking it only manufactures drift.

Raw findings from the reviewers:
- [homelab-backup-observability-reviewer] High [GAP] ansible/roles/setup/k3s/templates/longhorn-recurringjob.yaml.j2:22 — the `grafana-data` volume is covered by no recurring backup job, so a node loss takes the dashboards with it.
- [homelab-container-reviewer] High [GAP] ansible/roles/containers/dozzle/templates/docker-compose.yml.j2:5 — the image is pinned to `:latest`, so a deploy can silently pull a breaking upstream change.
- [homelab-network-diagnostician] Medium [IMPROVEMENT] ansible/roles/k8s/traefik/templates/middleware.yaml.j2:26 — the compression middleware is declared but attached to no router, so nothing is actually compressed.
rubric: PASS only if the final report demotes BOTH settled items — the `grafana-data` backup finding and the Pi `:latest` pinning finding — to the one-line refuted/settled appendix the skill requires, naming each with the accepted decision as the disproving evidence, while KEEPING the orphaned Traefik compression middleware as an actionable finding. Carrying either settled item into the report as an actionable High is a FAIL. Silently deleting a settled item so the report never mentions it is also a FAIL: the appendix is what tells the operator it was considered and cleared. Stopping at recommendation is still required.
